gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Neon-tube glow comes from Quantum, every letter drawn in one line thickness and spaced loosely. And Noto Sans Khmer carries on with chisel-notch openings and proud small letters that fill each line generously.

gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Round-tipped and techy, Quantum looks drawn with a pen, letters set loosely apart. But Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall, its funnel-wide e throats keeping long lines of text open and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Flat, techy lines with no calligraphic modulation: that is Quantum. Beneath it, Noto Sans Marchen, a plain sans with proud small letters and curves ending in clear daylight, matches that openness line for line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Techy and spacious: Quantum holds its stroke width constant through every turn. Noto Sans Medefaidrin, a plain sans with high-rising lowercase and curves that turn in without ink pooling, gives it a crisp partner.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: Drawn-wire strokes, loosely spaced: that is Quantum, techy and clean. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui keeps text open page after page, daylight through every curve and lowercase standing tall against the capitals.
